simplemachines.guide.page.1.title: Simple Machines
simplemachines.guide.page.1: The machine parts of the Simple Machines tab: four stronger pistons, the Double Piston, which reaches further than any Vanilla piston, and the Signal Dampener, a repeater that takes up to 3 off the signal.
simplemachines.guide.page.2.title: Piston upgrades
simplemachines.guide.page.2: Four stronger pistons: the Reinforced Piston and its sticky twin push 18 blocks and, paid with a Redstone Block, one unbreakable block;
simplemachines.guide.page.3.title: Piston upgrades
simplemachines.guide.page.3: the Netherite and Enderite Pistons break blocks by signal strength, wear out like tools and are repaired with their nugget. Until 03.11. SimpleBuilding's; old simplebuilding: ids move here.
simplemachines.guide.page.4.title: Double Piston
simplemachines.guide.page.4: One block that pushes in two stages: a signal of 1 to 7 brings the head out one block like a Vanilla piston, 8 to 15 moves the body half a block forward and the head a second block - three blocks long in all.
simplemachines.guide.page.5.title: Signal Dampener
simplemachines.guide.page.5: A flat redstone part like the Repeater that takes 0 to 3 off the signal and passes it on one redstone tick later.
simplemachines.guide.page.6.title: Creative tabs
simplemachines.guide.page.6: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).
simplemachines.guide.page.7.title: Commands
simplemachines.guide.page.8.title: Settings
simplemachines.guide.page.8: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
quests.simplemachines.start.title: Welcome to Simple Machines
quests.simplemachines.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simplemachines.start.welcome.desc: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Machines Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and redstone dust.
